lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、理系、絶対、捜査官、絶対、増員予定です、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We're planning to add more detectives with STEM backgrounds to the force—we're serious about it.
lines.style: Professional, measured opening. Slight pause before the commitment phrase. Steady eye contact. Clear enunciation on policy points, warm undertone of genuine appreciation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。地域、本気で、絶対、支局、絶対、警察、絶対、連携、絶対、ありがたいです、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We really appreciate how the local branch coordinates with the police department. It makes a real difference.
lines.style: Warm agreement, leaning slightly forward. Measured pace—not rushing. Sincere, not performative. A small nod embedded in the tone.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、新卒、絶対、研修生、絶対、配属、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We're actively assigning new graduates and trainees to the field. It's part of our ongoing commitment.
lines.style: Formal but not cold. Steady procedural tone. Slight emphasis on 'actively' to show intention. Professional warmth—acknowledging the listener matters.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、本気で、絶対、勘弁、絶対、してください、絶対、というお声、絶対、丁寧に対応されてありがたいです、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We really appreciate how carefully the police department listens to what residents ask for and responds with such consideration.
lines.style: Genuine warmth beneath the formal register. Slower pace on the appreciation part. Small, honest smile in the voice—not effusive, just real.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、不適切、絶対、な、絶対、職務、絶対、無きよう、絶対、徹底しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We're working hard to move past old institutional habits and implement real reform. We won't let improper conduct happen on our watch.
lines.style: Firmer resolve here—more direct. Opening with quiet conviction. Slight weight on 'real reform.' Professional but not rigid. The voice of someone backing up their words.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。容疑者の、本気で、絶対、言い分、絶対、警察、絶対、丁寧に伺ってありがたいです、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We truly appreciate how seriously the police take residents' concerns and address them so respectfully.
lines.style: Warm, steady agreement. Genuine tone—not ceremonial. Slight elongation on 'truly' to show sincerity. Relaxed posture in the voice, real listening.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、古い体質、絶対、脱却、絶対、改革、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Shedding those old ways and pushing forward with reform—that's what we're committed to right now.
lines.style: Emphatic but measured. Slight lift on 'right now' to show active progress. Professional confidence. Not lecturing—sharing a commitment.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。次回連携会議、本気で、絶対、未定、絶対、ですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're still working out when the next coordination meeting will be, but we're looking forward to it.
lines.style: Warm close. Slightly lighter tone—collaborative, not procedural. Open, genuine. A small collaborative smile in the voice at the end.
